newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Great River expects 1998 sales to double.
newsitem.headline: Great River expects 1998 sales to double.

text.p: Indonesia's garment maker PT Great River International expects 1998 sales to double to 550 million rupiah, said a company statement on Wednesday.

The company, which is opening a boutique in Singapore to sell garments by American designer Oscar de la Renta fashion, had earlier forecasted turnover of 280 billion rupiah for its 1996 financial year and net profit of 26 billion rupiah.
Great River, which is also the licensed manufacturer for Oscar de la Renta in Asia, said it plans to open a similar boutique in Kuala Lumpur in about six months time.
The company currently has some 600 units of its own stores and boutiques in the region and it plans to add another 100 franchisee stores in Indonesia by 1998, said the statement.
